item.title: USDA Proposes Increasing Poultry, Pork Line Speeds
item.description: The agency’s proposals would raise line speeds to up to 175 birds per minute for young chickens and up to 60 birds per minute for turkeys, plus eliminate the maximum line speed limit of 1,106 head per hour at pork establishments.

item.title: FDA Releases Produce Regulatory Program Standards
item.description: The Produce Regulatory Program Standards provide a uniform foundation across government produce regulators to advance an integrated food safety system that leverages collaboration and resources among federal, state, local and tribal agencies to protect public health, said the agency.

item.title: Sterling Expands GPL and LHE Chiller Lines for Use in Food and Beverage Production
item.description: GPL and LHE chillers support applications including chocolate, candy, baked snacks, fruit, ingredients, grain, dairy, meat, beer brewing, wine fermentation, distilleries and pet food.

item.title: Pitch Competition Returns to IFT FIRST Annual Event and Expo
item.description: Seeding The Future Foundation will once again be sponsoring the Startup Pavilion pitch competition at IFT FIRST Annual Event and Expo this July.

item.title: FDA Updates Infant Formula Resources
item.description: The update includes a new, publicly accessible list of all infant formulas available in the United States market.

item.title: Saputo Recalls Great Value Cottage Cheese Due to Possible Pasteurization Issue
item.description: The company is voluntarily recalling select cottage cheese products due to the possibility of liquid dairy ingredients used in the items not being fully pasteurized according to state regulatory standards.

item.title: Freshpet Becomes First Dog Food to Earn Clean Label Project Certification
item.description: This certification is awarded by the nonprofit Clean Label Project, which tests products for heavy metals, pesticides and environmental contaminants to evaluate ingredient quality and safety.

item.title: 360training Acquires Canadian Food Safety Group
item.description: The SafeCheck brands will continue certifying Canadian food service professionals under 360training's ownership.

item.title: QuantiPath Introduces Turkey KPI Kits for Salmonella Detection and Quantification
item.description: The kits are designed to help turkey producers detect, quantify and act on Salmonella risk within the same production shift.

item.title: Hormel Sells Whole-Bird Turkey Business to Life-Science Innovations
item.description: LSI will acquire assets from Hormel Foods, including the Melrose, Minn., whole-bird production facility; the Swanville, Minn., feed mill; and associated transportation assets.
